Parts.Description: Dark grass under a pale moon, a cobbled court before the crypt, a red carpet and muddy graves.
Parts.Name: Moonlit Graveyard

Parts.Description: A tall gothic arch of black stone with gargoyles, open iron gates and a crescent moon on top.
Parts.Name: Moon Gate

Parts.Description: The vampire's black stone hall: a pillared porch, a red door and a pointed roof with a spire.
Parts.Name: Crypt Hall

Parts.Description: Crooked tombstones, crosses and a weeping angel on a muddy graveyard plot.
Parts.Name: Tombstone Field

Parts.Description: Three tall iron lamps that glow a ghostly green along the road to the crypt.
Parts.Name: Gas Lamps

Parts.Description: A gnarled leafless tree with long claw-like branches, a crow and hanging bats.
Parts.Name: Haunted Dead Tree

Parts.Description: A black coffin with a red velvet bed and a gold cross, the lid leaning open on a stone dais.
Parts.Name: Open Coffin

Parts.Description: A three-tier stone fountain, brimming with deep red blood, with a bat on top.
Parts.Name: Blood Fountain

Parts.Description: Three stone gargoyles with bat wings crouching on pedestals, watching everyone who passes.
Parts.Name: Gargoyle Perches

Parts.Description: A black hearse carriage with a canopy, a coffin, green lanterns and big spoked wheels.
Parts.Name: Funeral Carriage

Parts.Description: Four tall iron candelabras around a stone altar with a skull and an old book.
Parts.Name: Candelabra Circle

Parts.Description: A crumbling chapel front with a pointed doorway, a broken gable and fallen stones.
Parts.Name: Ruined Chapel

Parts.Description: Big oak barrels, a bottle rack and a table with goblets of the vampire's favourite red drink.
Parts.Name: Blood Wine Cellar

Parts.Description: A tall gothic mirror with a black carved frame. Vampires have no reflection, so it shows nothing!
Parts.Name: Mirror of No Reflection

Parts.Description: A big iron cauldron of bubbling green brew over a fire, with a ladle and a pile of bones.
Parts.Name: Brew Cauldron

Parts.Description: A vampire hunter's cart piled with sharp wooden stakes, garlic and a crossbow. Brave, or silly?
Parts.Name: Hunter's Handcart

Parts.Description: A wall of stacked skulls and bones with a dark alcove, bone columns and little candles.
Parts.Name: Skull Ossuary

Parts.Description: A tall dark bell tower with a golden bell, a purple spire and bats hanging all around.
Parts.Name: Bat Belfry

Parts.Description: Dark green hedge walls trimmed into pointed towers, with a bat cut out of the hedge.
Parts.Name: Bat Topiary Garden

Parts.Description: A little family tomb of grey stone with urns and a weeping angel keeping watch on its roof.
Parts.Name: Angel Tomb

Parts.Description: A great pale moon in an iron ring on two tall posts, crowned with spikes.
Parts.Name: Blood Moon Totem

Parts.Description: A huge pipe organ with seven gleaming pipes, a black console, a bench and two flickering candles.
Parts.Name: Gothic Organ

Parts.Description: A tall black throne with bat wings and a red velvet seat on a stone dais, between two torches.
Parts.Name: Vampire Throne

Parts.Description: A gallows frame with two iron cages on chains, a skeleton inside and a crow keeping watch.
Parts.Name: Hanging Cages

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a huge stone bat-demon with spread wings and red eyes crouching on a plinth.
Parts.Name: Giant Bat Statue
